headline: Ingram Micro Thailand Dismisses Concerns Over Reported Nvidia Chip Shipment Halts
summary: Authorised Nvidia distributor Ingram Micro Thailand dismissed concerns over potential disruptions to AI server supplies following media reports that Nvidia halted shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.
why: Supply chain stability for high-end semiconductors is critical for regional technology distributors and AI infrastructure deployment.

impacts.name: NVIDIA Corporation
impacts.why: Reports and distributor comments concern the company's chip shipments to Southeast Asia.
